Generator Select
variable.tooltip:
HEP: This will change the steam generator sound effect to that of
a small diesel “pup” motor used to provide electrical power
for passenger cars in the train.

variable.label: True-Idle Enable
variable.tooltip:
When set, the engine will follow prototypical diesel locomotive operation
and RPM level will remain at idle when the DCC throttle is increased to speed step 1.
If disabled, the engine RPM level is set to notch 2 at speed step 1.

When loco has stopped and all functions are turned off, sound effects will turn
off automatically after timeout period has elapsed. Set to zero to disable.
variable.label: Quiet Mode Timeout Period (Seconds)

variable.tooltip: Controls how the engine RPMs interact with the speed step setting of the throttle
variable.label: Engine Notch Rate

variable.tooltip: When this option AND manual (notching) engine control is enabled, locomotive will not move until engine starts

variable.tooltip: Determines whether prime mover will start up automatically or manually

variable.tooltip: Controls how the dynamic brakes interact with the engine RPMs
variable.label: Dynamic Brake Override

variable.tooltip:
Adjust the motor response following a momentary power glitch
0 or 128 = Disabled
1-127 = Absolute Limiting (will return to this speed step)
129-255 = Proportional Limiting (a percentage of set speed)
variable.label: Motor Recovery Speed (0-255)

Poppet Valve Select
variable.tooltip:
Selecting the electronic air dryer option will modify the operation
of the automatic poppet valve sound effect to mimic the use of
a Salem or Graham-White type air dryer system.
Like the prototype, when this option is selected the release rate
will be much slower than the poppet valve effect.

variable.tooltip:
Determines the starting voltage level applied to the motor in analog mode;
The motor start voltage is calculated as a fraction of the available supply voltage.
Starting Voltage = (CV 218 ÷ 10) + 6V
variable.label: Analog Mode Motor Start Voltage (0-255)

variable.tooltip: track voltage in analog mode at which the exhaust sound begins
variable.label: Analog Mode Engine Start Voltage (0-255)

variable.tooltip:
determines the fixed distance over which the locomotive will decelerate to a stop after setting the throttle to zero
Entering a value of 0 will disable the constant brake distance feature
variable.label: Constant Brake Distance (0-255)
Prime Mover Pitch Shift
variable.tooltip:
Prime mover pitch shift allows for slight variations in the tone and pitch
between multiple locomotive using the same prime mover selection.
- Values 1 to 127: lower the pitch of the prime mover sound effect.
- Value 128: no effect on the tone or pitch of the prime mover sound.
- Values 129 to 255: increase the pitch of the prime mover effect.
adjust the cutoff frequency of the decoder’s high-pass output filter 1=20Hz, 255=1kHz, 0=disabled
variable.label: High-Pass Filter Cutoff Frequency

variable.tooltip:
Sets the maximum attenuation level of the exhaust sound when the
locomotive is under light load. (higher no. = greater attenuation)
variable.label: Prime Mover Low Volume Limit

variable.tooltip:
Sets the maximum volume level of the exhaust sound when the
locomotive is under heavy load. (higher no. = greater volume)
variable.label: Prime Mover High Volume Limit

variable.tooltip:
Determines the amount of time needed before the DDE processor will begin reshaping
the audio signal once the motor or throttle input signal has begun to change.
variable.label: Attack Time Constant

variable.tooltip:
Determines the amount of time needed before the DDE processor will stop reshaping
the audio signal after the motor or throttle input signal has returned to normal.
variable.label: Release Time Constant

variable.tooltip:

setting and the actual locomotive speed. Set to zero to disable.
variable.label: Throttle Sensitivity
